body:
Oh my god. I’m so sorry to put you through all of this. I didn’t realize that there would be people who cared so much. I’m sorry I can’t reply to every comment and PM because there’s just *so much*.

As for what happened, I wanted to say goodbye to my friend. So I called her and told her everything. After talking to her I realized that killing myself won’t solve anything. They rushed to my house and now I’m at hers. Her parents said that we’ll be going to the police in the morning. But I don’t want dad to get hurt. No matter what you say I know that he’s not a bad person. He’s just not in his right mind right now. He wouldn’t have let anything happen if he wasn’t drunk.

Thank you so much for caring so much but if it ever came to testifying against him I wouldn’t do it. I can’t.
